title: A piece of a life's record

codes.means: the piece.md has no YAML header, so none of the five questions is answered
codes.fix: write the header from docs/FORMAT.md (pieceText writes a new one)

codes.means: the folder or file name is not YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug
codes.fix: rename it to YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-slug, the moment it was made, and set id to match

codes.means: kind is missing or is not "piece"
codes.fix: set kind: piece

codes.means: the record names no standard, the bare unversioned piece URL written before versions, or another kind's standard
codes.fix: piece-md stamp <home> --apply adds or upgrades it; a record naming another kind's standard is not a piece, so move or fix it by hand

codes.means: the record names a version of the piece standard this validator does not implement
codes.fix: install the piece-md version that implements it, or rewrite the record to https://hypercontext.wiki/standards/piece/v1

codes.means: context_version is missing
codes.fix: set context_version: "1"

codes.means: context_version is not "1"
codes.fix: set context_version: "1"

codes.means: id is missing
codes.fix: set id to the folder name (the file name without .md for a one-file piece)

codes.means: id does not equal the folder or file name
codes.fix: set id to the name, or rename the folder to the id

codes.means: type is missing or not one of the piece types
codes.fix: set type to photo, screenshot, recording, video, image, document, note, deck or page

codes.means: summary is missing: what the piece is, in a line
codes.fix: write summary

codes.means: read_when is missing: when a reader should open this piece
codes.fix: write read_when

codes.means: audience is missing: who the record is written for
codes.fix: write audience

codes.means: source is missing: who or what made the piece
codes.fix: write source

codes.means: as_of is missing or not a YYYY-MM-DD date
codes.fix: set as_of to the date the record was true

codes.means: keep is missing or not keep, home or share
codes.fix: have a person choose keep, home or share; never infer it

codes.means: about is missing: the ids this piece is about
codes.fix: set about to a list of ids

codes.means: about is an empty list
codes.fix: name at least one person, superproject or place the piece is about

codes.means: taken is missing
codes.fix: set taken to a date, a date and time, or unknown

codes.means: taken is not a date, a date and time, or unknown
codes.fix: set taken to YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or unknown

codes.means: taken_from is missing: where the time in taken came from
codes.fix: set taken_from to device, filename, file-time, stated, inferred or unknown

codes.means: taken_from is not one of the time sources
codes.fix: set taken_from to device, filename, file-time, stated, inferred or unknown

codes.means: connections is missing
codes.fix: set connections to a list of links or ids; [] is allowed

codes.means: connections is empty, so nothing links to this piece
codes.fix: add a link to a person, a superproject or another piece

codes.means: a media piece has no files list, or files is not a list
codes.fix: add files: a row per file naming who is in it

codes.means: a file row names neither a path nor a link, or its link has no scheme
codes.fix: give the row a path inside the folder or a link with a scheme

codes.means: a file row's path leaves the piece's folder
codes.fix: use a path inside the folder, or a link for a file elsewhere

codes.means: a file row does not say who is in it
codes.fix: add people: [] for nobody, or a {id, confirmed} per person

codes.means: a person in a file row is not {id, confirmed: true|false}
codes.fix: write each person as {id, confirmed: false} until a person confirms them

codes.means: a media piece is a bare .md instead of a folder
codes.fix: move it to <name>/piece.md beside the media

codes.means: a one-file text piece names a file of its own, so it is a folder now
codes.fix: move it to <name>/piece.md beside that file

codes.means: a media file inside a piece's folder has no row
codes.fix: add a files row for it, naming who is in it

codes.means: a folder named like a piece holds no piece.md
codes.fix: write its piece.md, or rename the folder if it is not a piece

codes.means: a media file sits outside any piece
codes.fix: make it a piece: a folder named for its moment holding the file and its piece.md

codes.means: a symbolic link named like a piece was not checked, because a link is another tree's file
codes.fix: check the piece where it lives; replace the link with the piece itself if it belongs here
